name: Maximum Classes Are Strictly Contained in Their Tree-Amalgam Closure
statement: Every maximum class is a generator of $\mathfrak T$, and products or one-point amalgams produce nonmaximum members.
proof: Containment is definitional. The one-point amalgam of two squares lies in $\mathfrak T$, has VC dimension two on four active coordinates, and has seven rather than eleven concepts.
